lines.text: Isaiah son of Amoz receives a message about Judah and Jerusalem, and the LORD's mountain will rise above the hills.
Many peoples will go up the LORD's mountain to learn His ways, and they will beat swords into plowshares.
The LORD has abandoned Jacob's house because they are full of influences from the south and are soothsayers like Philistines.
The Day of the LORD of Hosts will come against the proud, like Lebanon's cedars and the oaks of Sharon.
On that day men will cast away their idols of silver and gold to the moles and bats.
